title: Hyaluronic acid
summary: naturally occurring polysaccharide used in skincare for moisture retention and skin hydration

presence.note: An ingredient the maker adds; the skin makes its own as well.

why_it_matters.text: A water-holding molecule the body makes to keep skin and joints plump and cushioned.

description: A water-holding molecule the body makes to keep skin and joints plump and cushioned. Hyaluronic acid is a compound that occurs naturally in the human body.
